title: Lively Laminate Kenyan Bacon Skillet
description: A mustardy and adventurous Kenyan dish featuring streaky bacon and lamination-puff, shojin-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Roll out the lamination puff to a thickness of about 1/8 inch
Cut the puff into small squares and set aside
In a large skillet, cook the streaky bacon over medium heat until crispy
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent
Add the kenyan spices, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the mustard to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the cooked bacon back into the skillet and stir to combine
Add the lamination puff squares to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired
